explanation: At each offset, try every prefix that is itself a palindrome, append it to the partial partition, and recursively decompose the remaining suffix.
timeComplexity: O(n²·2^n) upper bound including substring creation and palindrome checks
spaceComplexity: O(n²) active substring storage plus output
